thread:
sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem earlier today. We surfaced three repeating failure modes: quota exhaustion, scheduler preemption misordering, and insufficient warm capacity. We need owners + measurable deliverables. Keep replies short.
darren: I'll take quota backstop. Plan: submit cloud quota request + implement emergency overflow to partner pool. ETA request submitted by 2026-03-22, overflow config ready by 2026-03-29.
kevin: I'll own scheduler fixes (preemption ordering + pod packing heuristics). Will bench with the surge test harness and open PR for admission-controller changes. Target PR by 2026-03-24.
rachel: I'll own warm-capacity (WA/EU) and forecasting. I'll iterate on the demand model and propose warm-node minimums per zone. Draft by 2026-03-23.
ops-bot: Incident GPU_Surge_2026-03-18: follow-ups recorded. Tickets: INF-9001, INF-9002, INF-9003 added to remediation tracker.
sophia: Nice. Put these into the tracker with success criteria: what metric moves, what threshold, and how we verify. Short checklist in-thread if helpful.
darren: checklist:
- submit quota form (ticket number)
- add alert if compute-requests > quota-90%
- enable overflow route to partner-pool (dry-run)

kevin: checklist:
- unit perf test showing p99 < baseline under 3x load
- scheduler e2e with preemption order deterministic
- canary deploy to dev cluster + monitor for 48h

rachel: checklist:
- forecast model with 95% CI for 6 weeks
- define warm-node targets by zone
- automation to maintain warm-node minimums during high-variance windows

sophia: For recurring incidents, ops pattern: spikes on Wed mornings and early CET evenings. Proposal: automated surge-detect that triggers warm-node prefill + admission throttles. Keep automatic action to DRY_RUN first.
kevin: I'll add a surge detector alert: queue_latency > 300ms and gpu_util > 80% for 3m triggers DRY_RUN prefill. Config and alert rule by 2026-03-25.
darren: Note on quota timelines: cloud provider may take 7-10 business days for increases. We'll need the overflow route as short-term guard.
sophia: Meeting cadence: 20-min standup every Tue for 4 weeks to review metrics and unblock tickets. @rachel can you propose times?
rachel: Proposing Tue 09:30 UTC first meeting. I'll post calendar invite and link the tracker.
ops-bot: Jira links: https://internal-jira/browse/INF-9001 https://internal-jira/browse/INF-9002 https://internal-jira/browse/INF-9003
sophia: Final: add verification steps to each ticket (what we measure, baseline numbers, who validates) by EOD Fri. We'll close the incident when all tickets have verification + 2-week stable metric window. Thanks all.
